translations.zh: 庚申，扶風掘地得玉盃以獻。
translations.literal: On gengshen day Fufeng dug up a jade cup and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Fufeng dug up a jade cup and presented it.

translations.zh: 冬十月庚午，詔江陵所獲俘虜充官口者，悉免為民。
translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on gengwu day, an edict declared that captives taken at Jiangling who had been made government bondsmen were all released and returned to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on gengwu day, an edict declared that captives taken at Jiangling who had been made government bondsmen were all released and returned to commoner status.

translations.zh: 辛未，遣小匠師楊勰、齊馭、唐則使於陳。
translations.literal: On xinwei day Junior Artisan Yang Xie, Qi Yu, and Tang Ze were sent as envoys to Chen.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Junior Artisan Yang Xie, Qi Yu, and Tang Ze were dispatched as envoys to Chen.

translations.zh: 柱國、大司馬、綏德公陸通薨。
translations.literal: Pillar-of-State, Grand Marshal, Duke of Suide Lu Tong died.
translations.idiomatic: Pillar-of-State Lu Tong, Grand Marshal and Duke of Suide, died.
